# Visually checked real-file witnesses

No PDF bytes are committed. Sources and SHA-256 are the original manifest at
`docs/analysis/layout-eval-2026-10-09/corpus.json`. Fetch the four witnesses with
`uv run python scripts/fetch_layout_witnesses.py /tmp/layout-witnesses`, then run
`TPE_LAYOUT_CORPUS=/tmp/layout-witnesses cargo test --test layout_real_corpus -- --ignored`.
Native release CI runs this explicitly, including on macOS Apple Silicon.

`expected.json` contains short ordered prose anchors read from page images,
not generated by either extractor. Viewed using Poppler 24.02.0 `pdftoppm`
(scale-to 1600; Federal Register 1800). The assertions normalize whitespace only.
They establish specific column transitions, not full-page text correctness:

- Federal Register page 2: Hatta/Indonesia/Flight 610 and effects in column one;
  altitude/November 7/March 10 in column two; ECAA/data/unsafe condition in three.
- Aho–Corasick (`pwl04`) page 2: Figure 1, state/failure and operating-cycle
  explanation in the left column before the continuation and example on right.
- B-epsilon trees (`pwl11`) page 3: performance model and I/O costs through
  “times faster than a B-tree” before right-column write optimization/caching.
- Kalman (`pwl13`) page 2: Wiener/Dual/Applications/notation and scalar product
  through the left bottom before right-column quadratic form, notation table,
  and Optimal Estimates. The original visibly says “description or the type of
  problems”; this apparent original typo is not silently corrected.

Initial transcription errors in the `pwl11` anchors were corrected by revisiting
the rendered page, not by treating extraction as truth. Raw outputs from every
iteration stay separate outside the repository. The mathematical notation is
not validated by these prose witnesses. In particular Kalman pages 4 and 8 still
visibly interleave prose/equations across columns. The test requires Partial and
an unresolved-order warning on those pages rather than hiding the known failure.

At the exact baseline all four ordered-anchor witnesses fail. The same anchors
pass after the correction. The original corpus detector remains unmodified;
its comparison with Poppler is a defect indicator, not ground truth.
